name: link_tickets
title: Link tickets
description: Link two tickets of Zammad, as the ticket view does. Name the ticket that gets the link by its ticket_number, ticket_id or ticket_url, and the other ticket by other_ticket_number, other_ticket_id or other_ticket_url. link says what the other ticket is to the named one, as get_ticket names its links: parent (the parent of this ticket), normal (linked) or child (a child of this ticket). Two tickets are linked once; a link is neither changed nor removed here — the user does that in Zammad.

ticket_number.description: The ticket number as shown in Zammad, e.g. "31042" or "Ticket#31042".

ticket_id.description: The internal ID of the ticket, e.g. 8812.

ticket_url.description: A link to the ticket in Zammad.

other_ticket_number.description: The other ticket: the ticket number as shown in Zammad, e.g. "31042" or "Ticket#31042".

other_ticket_id.description: The other ticket: the internal ID of the ticket, e.g. 8812.

other_ticket_url.description: The other ticket: A link to the ticket in Zammad.

link.description: What the other ticket is to the named one: parent, normal or child.

url.description: A link to the ticket in Zammad.

ticket.description: The ticket that got the link.

url.description: A link to the ticket in Zammad.

other_ticket.description: The ticket it is linked to.

link.description: What the other ticket is to the ticket.

linked_before.description: The two were linked already; nothing changed, and link is the kind they have.
